metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the Oracle AI Data Platform Workbench Snowflake Migrator Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: oracle-ai-data-platform-workbench-snowflake-migrator
plugins.description: Snowflake to Oracle AI Data Platform migration driven from one config file: in-AIDP discovery, a reviewed translation plan, target structure created on AIDP compute, and one verified copy job per schema. Read-only against Snowflake, dry-run by default against AIDP.
